description: Feasibility of underground hydrogen storage in a salt cavern in the offshore Polda Basin is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Underground hydrogen storage (UHS) in halite caverns will become an essential technology to supplement energy supply networks. This study examines the feasibility of UHS in the offshore Polda Basin by integrating previous seismic interpretation, well data and regional geology information. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are Australia's Future Energy Resources, EARTH SCIENCES, EFTF, Exploring For The Future, Published_External. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
